text: Binary per-row flag from OC_comments (JSON list of other users' counter-argument comments, not the OP): 1 if at least one comment itself uses a specific, concrete illustrative example to support its own counter-argument, i.e. a particular named or described case, instance, event, scenario or personal experience, real or hypothetical, not externally verified. Abstract principles and vague generic references ("many people", "some cases") don't count; a quoted passage from someone else counts only if the comment uses it as its own example. Ignore text reporting the OP's view change or delta award, post-outcome thanks/resolution updates, and whether the outcome occurred; generic delta/platform-rule discussion stays eligible but is not itself an example. Output 0 if the list is valid but no comment qualifies, including an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or unparseable.
